verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents per-sync run reporting, a sync debugger for checking runs and rejected rows, and configurable alerts when a run fails. Each sync maps to a single destination, so failures can be diagnosed per destination, and a company comment on HN cites a 'live debugger' and alerting. However, the observability is framed around batch sync runs rather than watching events flow live, and delivery metrics are only implied by 'reports the outcome of each run'. Missing for 10: live event-stream debugger for Hightouch Events, documented per-destination delivery metrics or dashboards, independent hands-on corroboration of the debugger and alerting.
